newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss government to allow gene-altered soy imports.
newsitem.headline: Swiss government to allow gene-altered soy imports.

text.p: The Swiss Federal Department of Domestic Affairs (EDI) said it rejected an appeal to ban imports of food products containing gene-altered soy, and said such products could be imported immediately.
"Food products containing gene-altered soy can be immediately imported into Switzerland and brought onto the market," the EDI said in a statement.
